description: Building-grain staging view for the TAM semantic layer. No Looker joins are present. It preserves source columns and materializes reusable threshold and currency inputs without changing grain.
grain: One row per source TAM building record; property_id and cust_unified_building_id support building and customer-site distinct counts.
name: tam_buildings_staging
sql:
SELECT
  b.*,
  CASE
    WHEN lower(coalesce(trim(b.account), '')) IN ('', 'n/a', '0')
     AND lower(coalesce(trim(b.property_manager_name), '')) IN ('', 'n/a', '0')
     AND lower(coalesce(trim(b.owner_name), '')) IN ('', 'n/a', '0')
     AND lower(coalesce(trim(b.key_tenant_name), '')) IN ('', 'n/a', '0')
      THEN coalesce(b.building_rba, 0)
    ELSE greatest(
      coalesce(b.account_sf_total, 0),
      coalesce(b.property_manager_sf_total, 0),
      coalesce(b.owner_sf_total, 0),
      coalesce(b.key_tenant_sf_total, 0)
    )
  END AS _mv_sf_threshold_basis,
  b.customer_acv_year AS _mv_customer_acv_year_cad,
  b.customer_acv_year_usd AS _mv_customer_acv_year_usd,
  b.revenue_estimate_cad AS _mv_revenue_estimate_cad,
  b.revenue_estimate_usd AS _mv_revenue_estimate_usd,
  b.customer_gross_profit_cad AS _mv_customer_gross_profit_cad,
  b.customer_gross_profit_usd AS _mv_customer_gross_profit_usd,
  b.customer_revenue_cad AS _mv_customer_revenue_cad,
  b.customer_revenue_usd AS _mv_customer_revenue_usd,
  b.rate_cad AS _mv_rate_cad,
  b.rate_usd AS _mv_rate_usd
FROM databricks_prd.dbt_production.fct_tam_buildings b
WHERE
  (
    lower(b.property_manager_name) LIKE '%'
    OR lower(b.key_tenant_name) LIKE '%'
    OR lower(b.owner_name) LIKE '%'
    OR lower(b.cust_parent_customer) LIKE '%'
  )
  AND b.property_id <> '10630US'
  AND coalesce(b.sector, '') <> 'Residential'
  AND b.outside_geographic_tam = 'F'
  AND (b.building_rba IS NULL OR b.building_rba >= 20000)

yaml:
version: "1.1"
source: databricks_prd.semantic_migration_dev.tam_buildings_staging
parameters:
  - name: square_footage_threshold
    data_type: LONG
    default: 100000
  - name: currency
    data_type: STRING
    default: "'cad'"
dimensions:
  - name: consolidated_sector_2
    expr: NULLIF(TRIM(consolidated_sector_2), '')
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Consolidated Facility Type
    comment: Top-level facility segmentation used for market sizing.
    synonyms:
      - Consolidated Sector 2
  - name: consolidated_sector_2_sort
    expr: |-
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM(consolidated_sector_2), ''))), ''))), '') = 'Office' THEN 1
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM(consolidated_sector_2), ''))), ''))), '') = 'Industrial' THEN 2
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM(consolidated_sector_2), ''))), ''))), '') = 'Warehouse/Distribution' THEN 3
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM(consolidated_sector_2), ''))), ''))), '') = 'Manufacturing' THEN 4
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM(consolidated_sector_2), ''))), ''))), '') = 'Retail' THEN 5
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM(consolidated_sector_2), ''))), ''))), '') = 'Specialty' THEN 6
        WHEN NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM((NULLIF(TRIM(consolidated_sector_2), ''))), ''))), '') = 'Healthcare' THEN 7
        ELSE 999
      END
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Consolidated Sector 2 Sort
    comment: Numeric display order for consolidated facility type.
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Consolidated Sector 2 Sort
  - name: customer_bridge_bucket
    expr: |-
      CASE
        WHEN customer_match_status = 'Not a Customer' THEN NULL
        WHEN customer_match_status = 'Matched: In TAM' THEN
          CASE WHEN coalesce(building_rba, 0) >= 20000 AND _mv_sf_threshold_basis >= square_footage_threshold
               THEN '1 In TAM' ELSE '4 Excluded < Threshold (Size)' END
        WHEN customer_match_status = 'Matched: Excluded < 100k Sq Ft' THEN '4 Excluded < Threshold (Size)'
        WHEN customer_match_status = 'No Market ID' THEN
          CASE WHEN coalesce(parent_cust_sf_estimate, 0) >= square_footage_threshold
               THEN '2 In TAM (No Market ID)' ELSE '8 No Market ID - Excluded' END
        WHEN customer_match_status = 'Outside Geographic TAM' THEN '3 Outside Geographic TAM'
        WHEN customer_match_status = 'Matched: Excluded < 20k Sq Ft' THEN '5 Excluded < 20k'
        WHEN customer_match_status = 'Matched: Excluded by Property Type' THEN '6 Residential'
        WHEN customer_match_status = 'Matched: Excluded by Building Not Built' THEN '7 Excluded - Building Not Built'
        ELSE '9 Market Data Not Pulled'
      END
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Customer Bridge Bucket
    comment: MECE reconciliation bucket for active customers at the selected minimum account square footage.
    synonyms:
      - Customer Bridge Bucket
  - name: geo_label_for_map
    expr: territory
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Geo Label for Map
    comment: Map-ready geography label based on territory.
    synonyms:
      - map geography
      - territory label
      - Geo Label For Map
  - name: in_extended_tam_scope_flag
    expr: |-
      CASE
        WHEN customer_match_status = 'No Market ID'
          THEN coalesce(parent_cust_sf_estimate, 0) >= square_footage_threshold
        WHEN customer_match_status IN ('Matched: In TAM', 'Not a Customer')
          THEN coalesce(building_rba, 0) >= 20000 AND _mv_sf_threshold_basis >= square_footage_threshold
        ELSE false
      END
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings In Extended Tam Scope Flag (Yes / No)
    comment: Indicates eligibility for the extended TAM at the selected account square-footage threshold.
    synonyms:
      - In Extended Tam Scope Flag
  - name: market_passes_sf_threshold
    expr: |-
      coalesce(building_rba, 0) >= 20000
      AND _mv_sf_threshold_basis >= square_footage_threshold
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Market Passes Sf Threshold (Yes / No)
    comment: Indicates whether a market building passes the building and account-scale thresholds.
    synonyms:
      - Market Passes Sf Threshold
  - name: naics_code
    expr: RIGHT(naics, 6)
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Naics Code
    comment: Six-character NAICS code suffix.
    synonyms:
      - Naics Code
  - name: revenue_estimate_selected
    expr: |-
      CASE WHEN lower(currency) = 'usd'
           THEN _mv_revenue_estimate_usd
           ELSE _mv_revenue_estimate_cad
      END
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Revenue Estimate Selected
    comment: Per-row revenue estimate in the selected currency; CAD is the default.
    format:
      type: currency
      currency_code: CAD
    synonyms:
      - Revenue Estimate Selected
  - name: sector_sort
    expr: |-
      CASE
        WHEN sector = 'Office - Multi-Tenant' THEN 1
        WHEN sector = 'Office - Single-Tenant' THEN 2
        WHEN sector = 'Flex' THEN 3
        WHEN sector = 'Hospitals' THEN 4
        WHEN sector = 'Long Term Care' THEN 5
        WHEN sector = 'Healthcare - General' THEN 6
        WHEN sector = 'Manufacturing' THEN 7
        WHEN sector = 'Warehouse/Distribution' THEN 8
        WHEN sector = 'Food Processing' THEN 9
        WHEN sector = 'Data Centers' THEN 10
        WHEN sector = 'Industrial - General' THEN 11
        WHEN sector = 'Retail - General' THEN 12
        WHEN sector = 'Freestanding and Department Stores' THEN 13
        WHEN sector = 'Shopping Malls' THEN 14
        WHEN sector = 'Airports' THEN 15
        WHEN sector = 'Airplane Hangars' THEN 16
        WHEN sector = 'Schools' THEN 17
        WHEN sector = 'Sports & Entertainment' THEN 18
        WHEN sector = 'Hotels & Hospitality' THEN 19
        WHEN sector = 'Other' THEN 20
        ELSE 999
      END
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Sector Sort
    comment: Numeric display order for detailed facility type.
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Sector Sort
  - name: territory
    expr: territory
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Territory
    comment: Primary sales territory used for TAM planning and performance management.
  - name: account
    expr: account
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Account
    comment: Selected decision-maker stakeholder for the building (for example tenant, owner, or property manager) used for account-level TAM analysis.
  - name: account_number_buildings_total
    expr: account_number_buildings_total
    display_name: "Fct Tam Buildings Account # Buildings"
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Account Number Buildings Total
      - Account Number Buildings
  - name: account_sf_total
    expr: account_sf_total
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Account Sf Total
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Account Sf Total
      - Account Sf
  - name: address
    expr: address
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Address
  - name: branch
    expr: branch
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Branch
    comment: Operational branch location used for local service delivery (part of Region -> Territory -> Branch hierarchy).
  - name: building_name
    expr: building_name
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Building Name
    synonyms:
      - Building Name
  - name: building_rba
    expr: building_rba
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Building Square Footage
    comment: Rentable Building Area (RBA) in square feet. Primary size field used in TAM qualification and revenue potential calculations.
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Building Rba
  - name: building_status
    expr: building_status
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Building Status
    comment: Lifecycle status of the building (for example Existing, Under Construction, Demolished). Existing buildings are typically the TAM-eligible population.
    synonyms:
      - Building Status
  - name: city
    expr: city
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings City
    comment: City where the building is located.
  - name: country
    expr: country
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Country
    comment: Country for the building location (United States or Canada).
  - name: cust_original_building_id
    expr: cust_original_building_id
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Cust Original Building ID
    synonyms:
      - Cust Original Building Id
  - name: cust_unified_building_id
    expr: cust_unified_building_id
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Customer ID
    comment: Unified customer-system building identifier used for customer-level distinct counts and customer match metrics.
    synonyms:
      - Cust Unified Building Id
  - name: customer_match_status
    expr: customer_match_status
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Customer Match Status
    comment: "TAM qualification category for each building (for example Matched: In TAM, No Market ID, Excluded categories, Outside Geographic TAM). Use for customer bridge analysis; do not use this as the only filter for total TAM market sizing."
    synonyms:
      - Customer Match Status
  - name: customer_sf_estimate
    expr: customer_sf_estimate
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Customer SF Estimate (with No Market Data)
    comment: Estimated customer square footage used when market data is missing (No Market ID) so customer-adjusted TAM measures remain inclusive.
    format:
      type: number
    synonyms:
      - Customer Sf Estimate
  - name: secondary_type
    expr: secondary_type
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Facility Subtype
    synonyms:
      - Secondary Type
  - name: sector
    expr: sector
    display_name: Fct Tam Buildings Facility Type
    comment: Detailed facility type used for granular TAM segmentation within the consolidated facility groups.

    comment: Yes if the building is currently serviced by GDI; No for prospects/non-customers.
